prompt: Before 2024, among her own record-breaking streaks, in which Olympic event has Katie Ledecky broken the world record the second most times?
answer: The **women’s 800-meter freestyle**—Ledecky broke her own world record there **four times**, second only to her five improvements in the 1,500-meter freestyle.
